$schema.description: JSON Schema path or URL for editor help.

agentTests.description: Which shell commands the Dispatcher treats as tests and whether agents may run them locally.

allowLocal.description: Whether agents may run recognised test commands locally. CI may run them in either case.

testCommands.description: Additional executable names that start tests.

testScripts.description: Globs for script paths that start tests.

notTestCommands.description: Executable names for checks that do not run tests, even in a test-named package script.

evalConfigs.description: Globs for Vitest config paths that run evaluations instead of tests.

on.description: Rules to activate without changing their triggers.

off.description: Rules to deactivate, including their write refusals.
